label: inform users of AI interaction
definition: Providers shall ensure AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system.
source_quote: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system

term: AI Systems Intended to Interact Directly with Natural Persons
label: AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons
definition: AI systems that are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system.
source_quote: AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons

label: mark outputs as artificially generated or manipulated
definition: Providers of AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content shall ensure that the outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
source_quote: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, shall ensure that the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.

label: AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content
definition: AI systems that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text content.
source_quote: generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content

term: Inform Natural Persons of System Operation
label: inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system
definition: Deployers of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system.
source_quote: Deployers of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system

term: Emotion Recognition System and Biometric Categorisation System
label: emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system
definition: AI systems used for emotion recognition or biometric categorisation.
source_quote: emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system

label: disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated
definition: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.
source_quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake, shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.

label: AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake
definition: AI systems that generate or manipulate image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake.
source_quote: AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake

label: disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated
definition: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.
source_quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.

term: AI System Generating Public Interest Text
label: AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest
definition: AI systems that generate or manipulate text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest.
source_quote: AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest

label: encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level
definition: The AI Office shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level to facilitate the effective implementation of the obligations regarding the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content.
source_quote: The AI Office shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level to facilitate the effective implementation of the obligations regarding the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content.

label: The AI Office
definition: A public body that encourages and facilitates the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level to facilitate the effective implementation of the obligations regarding the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content.
source_quote: The AI Office shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level
